tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.description:
Snapshot of VN market with provenance. Use when a broad market picture is needed.

        symbols: tickers to quote — default the full VN30 basket (P14).
        as_of: requested timestamp label, recorded as requested_as_of
        (data is always latest).

tools.name: source_status
tools.description: Health of every upstream plus TTL state. Use to debug stale data.

tools.name: market_candles_batch
tools.description:
Batch OHLCV for symbols, one request per symbol. Use for multi-chart context.

        days: daily bars per symbol (max 100 symbols). summary/columns: summary
        returns {count,last,high,low} only; columns keeps named fields.

tools.name: symbol_lookup
tools.description:
Resolve company name to symbol, venue and sector. Use before any symbol-scoped call.

        limit: max hits returned (matched by symbol or company name,
        case- and accent-insensitive).

tools.name: market_movers
tools.description:
Top gainers, losers and volume leaders. Use for session pulse checks.

        top_n: rows per list.

tools.name: breadth_scan
tools.description:
Advancers, decliners, ceiling and floor counts. Use to judge rally health.

        exchange: filter rows carrying venue info (HOSE/HNX/UPCOM); ignored
        with a warning when rows carry no venue info.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description:
One-call market context: bluechip quotes, movers, breadth, session. Use for briefs.

        top_n: gainers/losers rows each. Breadth counts the bluechip board
        (breadth_scan covers the full Vietstock board). Legs degrade
        independently: a dead leg becomes null plus a warning.

tools.name: dnse_market_status
tools.description: DNSE session state plus latest index snapshot. Use for open/close checks.

tools.name: vn_quote_history
tools.description:
Candles for a VN symbol (1D/1W/1M), VCI then KBS fallback. Use for any price history.

        days: bars requested (max 365 nến; weekly/monthly span nhân hệ số).
        interval: '1D' (mặc định), '1W', '1M'. summary/columns: summary returns
        {count,last,high,low} only; columns keeps named fields.

tools.name: vn_equity_quote_batch
tools.description:
One-request price board for many symbols. Use for snapshots and movers.

        summary/columns: summary returns {count,symbols} only; columns keeps
        named fields per quote.

tools.name: vn_listing
tools.description:
Full symbol list with company names. Use for universe and lookup.

        limit: max symbols returned (universe ~1500).

tools.name: vn_fundamentals
tools.description:
Ratios and statements via vnstock Fundamental and Finance. Use for quick valuation.

        period: 'year' or 'quarter'. report_type: 'ttm' (trailing twelve months) or 'latest'.

tools.name: vn_retail_gold
tools.description:
SJC and ring gold buy/sell from BTMC retail. Use for local gold premium.

        source: retail source id (default 'btmc'). Direct BTMC https fetch
        first (15s); vnstock lib fallback (its http URL hangs without timeout).

tools.name: vn_retail_fx
tools.description: VCB USD buy/sell rates. Use for currency conversion context.

tools.name: vs_auth_status
tools.description: Vietstock JWT state and expiry. Use before any paid BCTC call.

tools.name: vs_financeinfo
tools.description:
Free-mirror statements, 12 quarters or years. Use when JWT is absent.

        period: 'quarter' (12 quarters) or 'year' (annual).

tools.name: vs_market_price
tools.description:
Live board snapshot from Vietstock. Use as secondary quote source.

        type: board id (2 = main board).

tools.name: vs_market_index
tools.description: Index closes with 1M and YTD change. Use for index context.

tools.name: vs_nn_flow
tools.description:
Foreign investor buy/sell chart. Use to cross-check DNSE WS flows.

        days: keep only the most recent N chart points.

tools.name: vs_categories
tools.description: Macro indicator catalogue (~60 categories). Use before indicator queries.

tools.name: vs_indicator_data
tools.description:
Macro series (GDP/CPI/FX/trade) via browser-session replay. Use for macro reads.

        term_type_id: 1 daily, 2 monthly, 3 quarterly, 4 yearly, 5 YTD, 6 MoM,
        7 YoY, 8 QoQ — pairs must match each category's ListTermType metadata
        (e.g. GDP 73 tt=3, CPI 15 tt=7 sub=2). from_date default 2022-01-01.
        Uses the full browser cookie jar (HAR/env seed); Standard pack serves it.
        Rows: {name, group, period, year, value, unit, timeorder}.

tools.name: vs_trading_info
tools.description: Ceiling, floor, room, EPS, BVPS, PE, PB per symbol. Use for reference snapshot.

tools.name: vs_financial_terms
tools.description: Report term catalogue (annual, Q1-Q4, H1, 9M). Use before BCTC value queries.

tools.name: vs_financial_norms
tools.description:
190+ BCTC line items for a business type. Use to resolve norm ids.

        btype: 1 CTCP (general), 2 securities, 3 bank, 5 insurance.

tools.name: vs_company_info
tools.description: Company names, exchange and description. Use for profiles.

tools.name: vs_overview_trading
tools.description: EPS, BVPS, PE, PB, ROEA/ROAA snapshot. Use for valuation inputs.

tools.name: vs_documents
tools.description:
Filings and disclosures with links. Use for corporate actions.

        page_size: max documents returned (default 60).

tools.name: vs_industry_tree
tools.description: GICS industry tree. Use before sector mapping.

tools.name: vs_industry_heatmap
tools.description: Live sector heatmap. Use for intraday rotation.

tools.name: vs_selftrading
tools.description: Prop-desk flow chart. Use alongside foreign flows.

tools.name: vs_gics_index
tools.description:
GICS index closes with foreign flow. Use for sector context.

        group: index set (1, 2 or 3 return different groups).

tools.name: vs_currency
tools.description: Reference FX table. Use as fallback FX source.

tools.name: vs_market_info
tools.description:
Per-exchange board row: index, breadth, put-through. Use for 5s snapshots in hours.

        exchange: HOSE, HNX or UPCOM (endpoint is per-exchange, not per-symbol).

tools.name: vs_xnk_detail
tools.description:
Import/export by country via browser-session replay. Use for trade structure.

        direction: 'xk' exports (cat 64), 'nk' imports (65). termType monthly,
        from_date default current year (ISO). Standard pack serves it; rows
        {name=country, group, period, year, value 'Triệu USD', timeorder}.

tools.name: vn_index_ohlcv
tools.description:
Index bars for VN tickers. Use for index history and breadth.

        interval: bar size ('1D' daily; intraday like '1m'/'15m' where supported).
        summary/columns: summary returns {count,last,high,low} only; columns keeps named fields.

tools.name: vn_equity_ohlcv
tools.description:
Equity bars via Market API. Use as OHLCV alternative to quotes.

        interval: bar size ('1D' daily; intraday like '1m'/'15m' where supported).
        summary/columns: summary returns {count,last,high,low} only; columns keeps named fields.

tools.name: vn_futures_ohlcv
tools.description:
Futures bars. Use for derivatives backtest input.

        interval: bar size ('1D' daily; intraday like '1m'/'15m' where supported).
        summary/columns: summary returns {count,last,high,low} only; columns keeps named fields.

tools.name: vn_forex_ohlcv
vn_crypto_ohlv
tools.description:
Crypto bars. Use for digital-asset regime reads.

        summary/columns: summary returns {count,last,high,low} only; columns keeps named fields.

tools.name: vn_global_index
tools.description:
Global index bars. Use as yfinance fallback.

        summary/columns: summary returns {count,last,high,low} only; columns keeps named fields.

tools.name: vn_reference
tools.description:
ICB reference by exchange, group or industry. Use for universe construction.

        by: 'exchange' (use exchange=HOSE/HNX/UPCOM), 'group' or 'industry'
        (use key=group/industry name).

tools.name: vn_company
tools.description:
Profile, holders and officers. Use for company research.

        detail: false returns profile only; true adds holders and officers (heavier).

tools.name: vn_msn_fx_gold
tools.description:
USDVND and XAUUSD via MSN. Use for gold-basis math.

        symbols: subset to fetch (default both); days: history depth.

tools.name: vn_trades
tools.description:
Tick-level matched trades. Use for microstructure reads.

        board: board filter (default all boards). from_date/to_date: ISO dates
        bounding the trade window.

tools.name: yf_global_indices
tools.description:
9 global benchmarks. Use for overnight context.

        tickers: subset override (default GLOBAL 9). period/interval: yfinance
        spellings ('2d', '1wk', '1mo'... x '1d'/'1wk').

tools.name: yf_commodities
tools.description:
Gold, oil, metals, BTC, VND and dollar index. Use for input-cost context.

        tickers: subset override (default COMMO 13). period/interval: yfinance
        spellings.

tools.name: yf_yield_curve
tools.description: US 2Y/10Y and inversion flag. Use for rates and regime context.

tools.name: yf_world_indices
tools.description:
24 world benchmarks. Use for global breadth.

        tickers: subset override (default WORLD 24).

tools.name: yf_oracle_markets
tools.description:
40 markets in 6 groups with 30d stats. Use for cross-asset state.

        groups: keep only named groups (crypto/metals/energy/agri/bonds_fx/index).

tools.name: yf_regime_assets
tools.description: 7 regime drivers with 2y history. Use for RISK-ON/OFF calls.

tools.name: yf_mega_flows
tools.description:
Mega-cap leader flows. Use to follow global smart money.

        top_n: leaders evaluated (default 15 of the ~20-name universe).

tools.name: yf_alloc_history
tools.description:
Long allocation history per asset. Use for regime backtests.

        asset: GC/VND/BTC/OIL/SILVER/COFFEE (unknown falls back to GC).
        timeframe: '1d' or '1wk'; returns last 60 closes over 5y.

tools.name: yf_market_pins
tools.description: 5-day pins for world majors plus VN watchlist. Use for brief headers.

tools.name: dnse_ohlc_history
tools.description:
Paginated futures/index bars via cursor. Use for VN30F1M backtest input.

        symbol: futures code (VN30F1M) or index (VN30). resolution: bar size in
        minutes (1/5/15/30/60). bar_type: 'derivative' for futures, 'index' for
        indices. from_date/to_date: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). summary: return only
        {symbol, count, last, high, low} instead of full bars. columns: keep only
        named fields per bar (t/o/h/l/c/v).

tools.name: dnse_latest_trade
tools.description:
Latest match price and totals per symbol. Use for realtime fallback.

        summary/columns: summary returns {count,symbols} only; columns keeps
        named fields per trade.

tools.name: dnse_foreign_flow
tools.description: Net foreign flow from WS cache. Use as primary smart-money read.

tools.name: dnse_ws_snapshot
tools.description:
Raw worker snapshot for symbols. Use to debug realtime staleness.

        symbols: channels to read (None reads VN30F1M+VNINDEX+VN30).

tools.name: dnse_orderbook
dnse_indices
tools.description:
Index snapshots from WS cache. Use for live index reads.

        symbols: index channels to read (default VNINDEX+VN30).

tools.name: dnse_vn30f1m_live
tools.description:
VN30F1M 1m bars aggregated to 15m with session remap. Use for intraday.

        bars: keep only the most recent N aggregated 15m bars.

tools.name: dnse_working_dates
tools.description:
Trading calendar. Use for session planning.

        year: keep only dates starting with this year (e.g. 2026). Actual
        trading dates; exchange_calendar holds static session mechanics.

tools.name: exchange_calendar
tools.description: HOSE/HNX/UPCOM hours, ATO/ATC, T+ settlement. Use for mechanics.

tools.name: crypto_spot
tools.description:
Binance spot 24h tickers. Use for crypto price and volume reads.

        symbols: up to 10, any of BTCUSDT / BTC/USDT / btc-usdt spellings.

tools.name: crypto_derivs
tools.description:
Binance futures funding, OI and long/short ratios. Use for leverage reads.

        symbols: up to 5 perpetual symbols (BTCUSDT ...). Rows carry per-symbol
        error instead of failing the batch when one symbol is delisted.

tools.name: stock_screener
tools.description:
Screen universe by valuation and quality. Use when hunting candidates.

        filters: {field: [min, max]} ranges (None side unbounded) or plain
        strings for symbol/exchange equality; use signals_screener_columns
        to discover valid fields. max_pe/min_roe are shortcuts for the same.
        technical: optional stage-3 timing filter on post-filter candidates
        ({rsi_lt, rsi_gt, above_sma20: true, below_sma20: true}).

tools.name: signals_screener_columns
tools.description:
Screener column catalog (valuation/quality/universe/price). Use to build filters.

        group: keep only that column group; search: keep columns whose
        key or label contains this substring (case-insensitive).

tools.name: signals_technical
tools.description:
Full technicals rating from local candles (daily only). Use for timing entries.

        indicators: keep only named outputs (e.g. rsi14, macd, sma20, recommend,
        patterns, support, resistance, rs_vs_bench, pos_52w, sma150);
        omit for the full set. interval other
        than '1D' is accepted but ignored.

tools.name: sector_performance
tools.description:
GICS heatmap rows. Use for sector rotation reads.

        level: GICS tree depth. top_n: rows returned.

tools.name: money_flow
tools.description:
Compose foreign flow: DNSE WS then Vietstock cross-check. Use for smart money.

        symbols: WS channels to read (default ["VNINDEX"]); falls back to
        Vietstock NN chart when cache is cold. Pair with block_trades for
        per-symbol negotiated put-through prints (different granularity).

tools.name: alert_check
tools.description:
Evaluate price/RSI rules against live quotes. Use for live watch.

        Each rule: {symbol, threshold, metric ('price'|'rsi14'), op ('>'|'gt'|'>='|'gte'|
        '<'|'lt'|'<='|'lte'|'cross_up'|'cross_down')}.

tools.name: stock_forensic
tools.description:
Beneish M-Score + Piotroski F-Score from FULL detailed statements (P15).

        Sources: KQKD/CDKT/LCTT detail (real per-quarter lines incl. receivables,
        cash, CFO). M-Score is 7-index (DEPI excluded — not exposed); full
        formula only when every input exists, else partial with missing list.
        F-Score: 6 of 9 items on Standard pack (CFO from LCTT is empty upstream;
        share-count item unavailable); 8 of 9 when BCTC paid unlocks LCTT.
        detail=true adds raw input series.

tools.name: valuation_run
tools.description:
PER/PB ensemble with DCF-lite. Use for fair-value ranges.

        btype: 1 general, 2 securities, 3 bank, 5 insurance. method: 'auto'
        (default, picks by btype) or force 'dcf'/'per'/'pb'/'ev'/'ensemble'.

tools.name: fred_series
tools.description:
FRED observations. Use for US macro context.

        series_id like 'DGS10'; spark adds a value-only sparkline list.

tools.name: world_macro_country
tools.description:
WorldBank series per country. Use for global GDP/CPI/debt context.

        iso3: 3-letter country code (VNM/USA); indicator like 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG'.
        limit caps returned points.

tools.name: world_fear_greed
tools.description:
Crypto fear/greed index. Use for risk-appetite reads.

        limit: number of recent daily readings returned.

tools.name: sentiment_score
tools.description:
Crowd sentiment from Fireant posts, Groq-scored. Use for hype risk.

        limit: max posts scored; without Groq key falls back to likes heuristic.

tools.name: insider_trading
tools.description:
Insider deals via vnstock Company. Use for informed-flow reads.

        limit: max deals returned.

tools.name: stock_overview
tools.description: Trading info plus company profile. Use for quick dossiers.

tools.name: company_events
tools.description:
Classified disclosures and corporate actions. Use for event calendars.

        types: comma-separated kinds to keep, matched against kind/type
        fields (e.g. 'bctc,nghi_quyet'). corporate_calendar is the raw
        unfiltered feed; company_events classifies it per symbol.

tools.name: financial_statements
tools.description:
Mirror statements alias (v3 compat). Use for statement reads.

        Wraps vs_financeinfo (no JWT needed). statement: which statement
        section to return ('all', or a section key like 'KQKD'/'CDKT');
        periods_n caps returned periods.

tools.name: financial_ratios
tools.description:
Overview plus vnstock ratios merged. Use for ratio screens.

        set: keep only ratio keys containing this substring ('all' keeps all).
        period: statement period ('year'); peers: extra symbols merged as list.

tools.name: peer_compare
tools.description:
Head-to-head overview rows. Use when picking tickers.

        peers: up to 5 extra symbols. metrics: keep only matching ratio keys
        (symbol column always kept).

tools.name: signals_scan
tools.description:
Donchian-20d breakout scan. Use to hunt momentum across the market.

        Default universe: 10 bluechips. exchange='HOSE' scans the exchange
        list capped at max_symbols (P14: up to 300, semaphore 5, progress +
        truncated honest). Scanning hundreds takes minutes — cache the call.

tools.name: pattern_match
tools.description:
Self-similarity of return windows by correlation. Use for analogies.

        lookback: daily closes fetched (window is last 20 bars). limit: top-N
        matches by correlation (best_* fields describe rank 1).

tools.name: snapshot_history
tools.description:
Daily-snapshot history saved by the worker. Use for data that vanishes.

        kind: market_board, breadth_3ex, flows_charts (NN/prop 30d rolling),
        heatmap_gics, gold_btmc, sbv_rates, nso_releases, analyst_titles,
        macro_curated, vn30_quotes, futures_basis, documents_feed, events_feed.
        days: history depth (newest first).

tools.name: event_stats
tools.description:
GDELT event counts for a query. Use for base-rate checks.

        limit: max articles fetched from GDELT.

tools.name: compare_assets
tools.description:
Cross-asset last prices via yfinance. Use for allocation reads.

        assets: yfinance tickers (max 10). timeframe: '1d' (2d/1d),
        '1wk' (3mo/1wk), '1mo' (1y/1d) download window.

tools.name: runs_list
tools.description:
Local run registry. Use to resume analysis sessions.

        id: filter by run id substring; use run_get for one full run.

tools.name: run_get
tools.description:
Local run registry fetch. Use to inspect past outputs.

        run_id: exact id from runs_list output.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Local self-check: env keys present, package versions. Use before handoff.

tools.name: dividends_splits
tools.description:
Cash dividends and share issues/splits. Use for payout history.

        region: 'vn' (vnstock Company events: DIV cash, ISS bonus/private) or
        'world' (yfinance actions). limit: max events returned.

tools.name: holders
tools.description:
Shareholder and institutional holder tables. Use for ownership reads.

        region: 'vn' (vnstock shareholders) or 'world' (yfinance).
        kind: 'major'|'institutional'|'mutualfund'|'all' (world only;
        vn returns shareholders for any kind).

tools.name: event_calendar_vn
tools.description:
Vietstock corporate-action calendar. Use for dividend/meeting/listing dates.

        event: 'dividends' (payouts, bonus, issues), 'listings', 'meetings'.
        symbol: filter one ticker (omit for market-wide). No earnings-report
        dates exist upstream; KQKD dates come from company_events instead.

tools.name: block_trades
tools.description:
Matched vs negotiated put-through splits per day. Use for dark-pool-style reads.

        from_date/to_date: ISO dates (default last 30d). pt_vol/pt_val are the
        thỏa thuận leg; pt_pct is its share of daily value.

tools.name: analyst_consensus
tools.description:
Analyst ratings and price targets parsed from report titles. Use for street views.

        symbol: filter one ticker (omit for latest across market). Ratings come
        from title text (MUA/BÁN/NẮM GIỮ...), not a consensus feed; history per
        symbol shows upgrades/downgrades by history.

tools.name: ipo_calendar_vn
tools.description:
HNX auction calendar plus announcement fallback. Use for upcoming supply.

        Calendar is often empty (no scheduled auctions); announcements carry
        the latest auction news with dates.

tools.name: futures_basis
tools.description:
VN30F1M price minus VN30 spot. Use for premium/discount reads.

        DNSE exposes no open-interest field, so no OI is reported; basis_bps
        is (futures-spot)/spot in basis points. Futures leg prefers the latest
        trade, falling back to the last 15m ohlc bar (trades/latest is often
        empty); spot accepts raw or normalized candle keys.

tools.name: planned_targets
tools.description:
Business-plan targets (CTKH: planned revenue/profit by year). Use as expectation anchor.

        years: latest N plan years (unit VND billions). Browser-session replay
        (HAR/env seed); reports unavailable while the gate rejects — mirror +
        analyst_consensus cover expectations meanwhile.

tools.name: financial_detail
tools.description:
FULL detailed statements, every line item per period. Use for deep BCTC reads.

        statement: KQKD (income), CDKT (balance), LCTT (cashflow), TM (notes),
        BCTT. periods_n: recent permitted periods (unit VND billions; only
        IsShowData_Permission=True periods). Real values on the Standard pack
        via browser-session replay (HAR/env seed) — rows {norm_id, name,
        values[...]}; report unavailable when the session gate rejects.

tools.name: watchlist_create
tools.description: Create a named watchlist. Use to start tracking a symbol group.

tools.name: watchlist_list
tools.description: List all watchlists with their symbols. Use to recall tracking state.

tools.name: watchlist_get
tools.description: Get one watchlist's symbols by id. Use before quoting a saved set.

tools.name: watchlist_add
tools.description: Add symbols (deduped, uppercase) to a watchlist. Use to track more.

tools.name: watchlist_remove
tools.description: Remove symbols from a watchlist. Use to trim tracking.

tools.name: watchlist_delete
tools.description: Delete a watchlist and its items (cascade). Use to clean up.

tools.name: watchlist_update
tools.description: Rename a watchlist. Use sparingly; names are unique labels.

tools.name: alert_create
tools.description:
Create a stored alert rule (input to alert_check). Use for live watch.

        metric: 'price' or 'rsi14'. op: '>'/'>='/<'/'<=' (aliases 'gt'/'gte'/
        'lt'/'lte' accepted). threshold: comparison value for the metric.

tools.name: alert_list
tools.description: List stored alert rules (active and paused). Use before alert_check.

tools.name: alert_delete
tools.description: Delete a stored alert rule by id. Use to clean up alerts.

tools.name: alert_pause
tools.description: Pause a stored alert rule (active=false). Use to silence alerts.

tools.name: alert_resume
tools.description: Resume a paused alert rule (active=true). Use to re-enable alerts.

tools.name: quant_backtest
tools.description:
Buy-and-hold backtest with costs over available history. Use for baseline stats.

        strategy: recorded label only (engine is buy-and-hold). cost_bps/slippage_bps:
        round-trip bps each deducted twice from gross. benchmark: reference index label.

tools.name: quant_risk
tools.description:
Sharpe, max drawdown and win rate from a return series. Use to gate models.

        returns: per-period simple returns. periods_per_year: annualization
        factor for Sharpe (252 daily, 52 weekly, 12 monthly).

tools.name: quant_factors
tools.description:
Momentum, volatility and drawdown factors from candles. Use to expand features.

        lookback: daily closes fetched (20d factor windows fixed); also adds
        max_dd_full_pct over the full window.

tools.name: scenario_simulate
tools.description:
Apply a price shock to latest close and report P/L per 1000 shares. Use for sizing.

        shock_pct: percent shock, negative for drops (e.g. -5.0).

tools.name: correlation_matrix
tools.description:
Pairwise Pearson correlation of daily returns. Use for diversification reads.

        symbols: up to 8 tickers (same market). days: daily bars each.
        Dates inner-join; vnstock day-only labels fall back to business-day
        walkback (see date_note).

tools.name: seasonality
tools.description:
Rolling-window return stats per calendar month. Use for seasonal bias.

        window: trading days per window, 5-63 (21 ~= month). Buckets by window
        end month; vnstock day-only labels use business-day walkback.

tools.name: backtest_strategies
tools.description:
Rule-based backtests beyond buy-and-hold. Use to compare timing rules.

        strategy: 'sma_cross' (fast SMA over slow), 'momentum' (close over
        close[slow] ago), 'buy_hold'. fast/slow: lookback bars. cost_bps:
        in+out bps deducted per position flip.

tools.name: portfolio_optimize
tools.description:
Long-only weights by rule. Use for allocation starting points.

        objective: 'equal', 'inv_vol' (1/sigma), 'max_sharpe' (closed-form
        long-only heuristic, no scipy). days: daily bars each (max 8 symbols).

tools.name: param_sweep
tools.description:
Grid-search strategy lookbacks, ranked by net return. Use to avoid overfit picks.

        fast_range/slow_range: candidate bars (product capped at 30 combos).

tools.name: brief_build
tools.description:
Compose morning brief from news, odds and calendars. Use at session start.

        scope: 'vn' or 'world'. date: ISO date the brief is for (recorded as-is).
        calendars: also attach IPO/macro/SBV sections (sbv_rates, macro_events_vn,
        ipo_calendar_vn); off by default to keep the brief fast.

tools.name: news_market
tools.description:
Market news: Fireant posts first, GDELT fallback. Use for catalyst checks.

        sources: 'gdelt' routes straight to GDELT. Default reads the Fireant
        crowd feed (token from env) and falls back to GDELT when empty.

tools.name: news_symbol
tools.description:
Symbol news: Fireant posts about the ticker, GDELT fallback. Use to verify rumors.

        sources: 'gdelt' routes straight to GDELT. Default reads Fireant posts
        tagged with the symbol and falls back to GDELT when empty.

tools.name: economic_calendar
tools.description:
Macro series catalogue as event proxy. Use for data-availability checks.

        scope: 'vn' only (others return empty with a warning). limit: max series.
        Not a real calendar; for trading dates use dnse_working_dates instead.

tools.name: sbv_rates
tools.description:
SBV policy and interbank rates, scraped static page. Use for rate regime.

        Values change rarely; upstream has no API.

tools.name: macro_events_vn
tools.description:
NSO release listings with reference and next dates. Use for data calendar.

        Covers CPI schedule and releases; full year schedule lives in an NSO PDF.

tools.name: corporate_calendar
world_prediction_odds
tools.description:
Polymarket odds via jina proxy to Gamma, then direct. Use for Fed/macro odds.

        query: substring in title/slug/description. tag: Polymarket tag
        (e.g. 'economics', 'fed', 'crypto'). Rows carry outcomes + prob_pct,
        sorted by 24h volume.

tools.name: polymarket_event
tools.description:
One Polymarket event detail by slug (every market + odds). Use to drill in.

        slug: from world_prediction_odds rows. Returns description, markets
        with outcome probs, volumes and end dates.

tools.name: geo_intel
tools.description:
Geopolitical coverage via GDELT. Use when geopolitics threatens markets.

        limit: max articles. days: keep articles from the last N days
        (undated articles are kept).

tools.name: assets_rotation
tools.description: Cross-asset 1y momentum classes into RISK-ON/OFF. Use for allocation reads.

tools.name: compare_equities
tools.description:
Head-to-head overview rows and momentum. Use when picking tickers.

        metrics: keep only matching row keys (symbol column always kept).

tools.name: evidence_bundle
tools.description:
Lock weighted conclusion by evidence bundle. Use last for final verdict.

        claim_ids: claim ids to lock; calc_ids: supporting calculation ids
        (pass [] when none).

tools.name: oracle_meta
tools.description: Aggregator snapshot plus source health. Use for dashboard meta.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description:
Fetch a URL and convert to markdown, text or html. Use for reading web content.

        format: 'markdown' (default), 'text' or 'html'. timeout_seconds: max
        fetch time (default 30).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description:
Search the web via Exa/Parallel providers. Use for up-to-date information.

            num_results: results requested (default 8). livecrawl: 'fallback' uses
            cached index first, 'preferred' crawls live. search_type: 'auto' (default),
            'fast', or 'deep'. context_max_chars: cap on returned context.

prompts.name: morning_briefing
prompts.description: Compose the session-open brief. Use at market open.

prompts.name: ticker_analysis
prompts.description: Deep dive on one ticker. Use before recommending a name.

prompts.name: pre_earnings
prompts.description: Reliability grade before earnings. Use when results are near.

prompts.name: sector_rotation
prompts.description: Rotate across sectors. Use for allocation reads.

prompts.name: ai_detect
prompts.description: Breakout detect (SEPA-style heuristic). Use to hunt or validate breakouts.

prompts.name: risk_check
prompts.description: Pre-trade risk checklist. Use before sizing any position.
